findings.body: The new review workflow runs the OpenAI agent against PR code and instructs mutation to be blocked, but `apply_unified_diff` is exported as a function tool for all agent tasks and directly runs `git apply --whitespace=nowarn`. `reject_unsafe_shell_command` only protects `run_shell_command`, so a review task can still modify the working tree before later summary/publish steps. This creates a trust-boundary/regression risk for the read-only review job; restrict the patch tool to repair/stabilization tasks or make review runs register only read-only tools.
findings.title: Review agent can still mutate the checkout via apply_unified_diff

summary: Found one concrete regression in the new agent tool boundary: the shell tool blocks mutating git commands but the exposed patch tool still allows repository mutation during review runs.
